themes.title: Fuel Price Crisis Sparks Tax Cut Calls
themes.blurb: Right‑wing parties in Norway and the United States are pushing immediate relief measures as diesel and gasoline prices hit record highs. Norway’s coalition parties demand a year‑long fuel tax cut, while President Trump touts a European diesel release to curb U.S. fuel costs.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FRP, Sp and KrF unite to demand fuel‑tax reductions for the rest of the year.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump announces Europe will release 100 million barrels of diesel to lower U.S. fuel prices.
